def enc_bytes(data, k0=0x42):
    k=k0; out=[]
    for p in data:
        c=p^k; k=(k+c)%256; out.append(c)

import subprocess
outs=set()
for D in range(256):
    p=subprocess.run(['/app/encrypt','-d'], input=bytes([D]), capture_output=True)
    assert len(p.stdout)==1
    outs.add(p.stdout[0])
print(len(outs), sorted(hex(x) for x in outs))
# also test encrypt direction single byte
outs2=set()
for P in range(256):
    p=subprocess.run(['/app/encrypt'], input=bytes([P]), capture_output=True)
    outs2.add(p.stdout[0])
print("enc distinct:", len(outs2))
# check encrypt then decrypt roundtrip for all single bytes

    c=subprocess.run(['/app/encrypt'], input=bytes([P]), capture_output=True).stdout
    d=subprocess.run(['/app/encrypt','-d'], input=c, capture_output=True).stdout
    if d!=bytes([P]):
        mismatch+=1
print("single-byte roundtrip mismatches:", mismatch)
# check what decrypt(encrypt(message)) gives vs source model
PY"],"command":"bash","cwd":"/app"}
